description_full: Topaz Energy Corp. operates as a royalty and infrastructure energy company in Canada. It operates through Royalty Production and Infrastructure segments. The company holds royalty interests on approximately 9 million gross acres of developed and undeveloped lands. It is also involved in operating natural gas processing facilities; and associated crude oil and condensate handling facilities, as well as water management infrastructure. The company was formerly known as Exshaw Oil Corp. and changed its name to Topaz Energy Corp. in November 2019. Topaz Energy Corp. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Calgary, Canada.

financial_summary: TOPAZ ENERGY CORP. is a mid-cap energy business with a $3.2B market cap on $228M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at -5% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome. Operating margins are expanding by +4.7pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 6% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 50%.

The business throws off $125M in free cash flow — roughly 55 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.40× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 1.9× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 6.3×.

Shareholder yield of 4.6% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 7.3% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 4.7× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
